definition: Y_{i,w} = mean_{t in w} |LN(t)|, LN = lane deviation from centre line (m)

lane_centre.basis: the release's own lane vocabulary: 4220 'moves right of the defined lane of travel' fires where LN>0 and 4230 'moves left' where LN<0

1001|ds004118.note: the release's own lane vocabulary predicts 4220 (right of lane) only where LN>0 and 4230 (left of lane) only where LN<0, if and only if LN is signed lateral deviation about the lane centre

1001|ds004120.note: the release's own lane vocabulary predicts 4220 (right of lane) only where LN>0 and 4230 (left of lane) only where LN<0, if and only if LN is signed lateral deviation about the lane centre

3101|ds004118.note: the release's own lane vocabulary predicts 4220 (right of lane) only where LN>0 and 4230 (left of lane) only where LN<0, if and only if LN is signed lateral deviation about the lane centre

3101|ds004120.note: the release's own lane vocabulary predicts 4220 (right of lane) only where LN>0 and 4230 (left of lane) only where LN<0, if and only if LN is signed lateral deviation about the lane centre

window_rules.block: split the 3200 grid at gaps > 90 s
window_rules.5min: contiguous spans >= 300 s, boundaries on 3200 onsets, overrun <= 1 tile period
window_rules.tail: shorter than 300 s -> complete_300s = false, excluded from primary summaries

reml.identifiability_note: with 2 subjects the between-subject component rests on 1 df; read as an upper bound on how large it could be, not as an estimate

E1_semantic_validity.what_the_endpoint_means: mean absolute lane deviation from the lane centre in metres, L(t)=|LN(t)|

evidence.channel_documentation: LN = 'Lane deviation from center line in meters.' (*_channels.tsv description, verbatim)
evidence.task_documentation: subjects were instructed to return the vehicle to the center of the lane (both READMEs, verbatim)
evidence.centre_identified: the release's own lane vocabulary fires where the vehicle is 'right of'/'left of' the defined lane of travel; every 4220 falls at LN>0 and every 4230 at LN<0

E1_semantic_validity.residual_caveat: the signing convention (which side is positive) is undocumented and is NOT needed: |LN| is sign-free. What the test establishes is that LN=0 is the lane centre, not which side is which.
E1_semantic_validity.open_scientific_question: the endpoint can in principle be driven far outside the lane: the T2 preflight recording reaches |LN| = 31.5 m with 24.7 % of time beyond the 0.917 m boundary, and contains the sample's only collision and its four near-misses. Whether 'mean |LN|' and 'hard safety failure' should be one target or two is a WHAT decision for the PI and is NOT resolved here.

evidence.quantisation: float32 with continuous steps; no integer lattice, so no quantisation floor to correct for
evidence.reconstruction_is_reproducible: the valid window is re-derived from the bytes in this lane and agrees with Phase 3B's `vehicle_effective_sampling.csv` pad values to floating point

evidence.source: Phase 3B `temporal_alignment.csv`, verdict FULL on all four recordings; Phase 3C re-derives the valid window and agrees

E3_temporal_linkage.note: Phase 3C does not use EEG, so E3 is about the *behavioural* series being locatable in time, which it is to the sample.

evidence.rule: pre-declared: a range of at least 0.05 m across 5-minute windows is required. Observed 0.21-0.24 m on the four Tier-1 recordings, i.e. 4-5x the threshold; the T2 preflight recording reaches 2.70 m, two orders of magnitude above it.
evidence.not_a_fatigue_claim: this establishes that the target varies within a person; it does not establish that it declines
evidence.scale_warning: the dynamic range is NOT homogeneous across participants: the T2 preflight recording's range is 11-13x the Tier-1 ranges, so a single pooled variance would be dominated by such participants. This is a property of the cohort, not a defect of the endpoint, and it is a reason the cohort-scale audit was requested rather than assumed.

evidence.condition_cycle_is_a_measurable_period: tile markers arrive at a median spacing of 38.5-40.2 s in every recording, and 6 blocks are separated by >90 s gaps that match the documented 6-block protocol

perturbation_rate_factor_not_recoverable.consequence: the 2x2 condition labels cannot be recovered behaviourally, so a condition-label model is NOT fitted; the observable cycle and the block are used instead

evidence.separability_argument: time-on-task contrast is expressible (T_session spans 0.7-1.2 h), the documented condition cycle is expressible (T_local within a ~40 s tile), and the block effect is expressible, so the brief's key diagnostic — naive vs condition-aware — is constructible rather than blocked

evidence.local_validation_sample: 2 participants x 1 baseline recording each (T1 64ch@2048 and T3 256ch@1024), which is what the endpoint reconstruction is demonstrated on
evidence.rule: pre-declared: >= 30 independent participants with usable Baseline vehicle data. This is a *metadata* count from the frozen index; the behavioural audit itself has NOT been run at cohort scale (see the access plan) — the count establishes that the cohort exists, not that the endpoint has been validated on it.

caveats: systematic leftward offset: mean LN is negative in all recordings and grows in the Baseline arm, so mean |LN| mixes mean position with dispersion
one participant per site class in the validated sample
the task can be failed outright: |LN| reaches 31.5 m and one collision exists in the T2 preflight recording
no reliable time-on-task decline was found
